# Load data

```{r}
ps_rare_16S <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))
ps_rare_ITS <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))

# Make data fit for plot
B = phyloseq::psmelt(ps_rare_16S) 
# Possible to focus on a reduced dataset ex. B = subset_taxa(S_ps_rare_16S, Genus == "Chlamydiae")

B$LifeStage <- factor(B$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
B$FruitType <- factor(B$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

# write.table(x=B, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "16S_melt.csv"), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=";")


L = phyloseq::psmelt(ps_rare_ITS)

L$LifeStage <- factor(L$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
L$FruitType <- factor(L$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

# write.table(x=L, file=file.path(here::here(),"data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "ITS_melt.csv"), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=";")
```

``` {r}
# Distinguish "Unknown" families by numeroting them with their corresponding cluster number

tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_16S)) # Extract taxonomy table as a data frame
otu_names <- rownames(tax) # Extract OTU names

tax$Family <- ifelse(
  tax$Family == "Unknown",
  paste0("Unknown_", sub("Cluster_", "", otu_names)), # Add suffix with cluster number if Family == "Unknown"
  as.character(tax$Family))

tax_table(ps_rare_16S) <- as.matrix(tax) # Put it back into the phyloseq object
write.table(tax_table(ps_rare_16S), file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "16S_TM1&2_tax_table_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)


tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_ITS)) # Extract taxonomy table as a data frame
otu_names <- rownames(tax) # Extract OTU names

tax$Family <- ifelse(
  tax$Family == "Unknown",
  paste0("Unknown_", sub("Cluster_", "", otu_names)), # Add suffix with cluster number if Family == "Unknown"
  as.character(tax$Family))

tax_table(ps_rare_ITS) <- as.matrix(tax) # Put it back into the phyloseq object
write.table(tax_table(ps_rare_ITS), file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "ITS_TM1&2_tax_table_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)
```

# I. Composition (abundance)

## 1. Bar plots

### a. Fruits 
```{r}
# subset data
ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))

ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))
```

#### SampleType + FruitType
```{r}
# 16S (Family)
plot_16S_SampleTypeFruitType <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly, "Bacteria", "Family", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType, color_16S)

plot_16S_SampleTypeFruitType$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_16S_SampleTypeFruitType$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days")) # reorder sample type 

ggsave(filename = "B_Abundance_Sample_Type_Fruit_Type.jpg", plot = plot_16S_SampleTypeFruitType, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")


# ITS (Family)
plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly, "Fungi", "Family", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType, color_ITS)

plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days")) # reorder sample type 

ggsave(filename = "Y_Abundance_Sample_Type_Fruit_Type.jpg", plot = plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")


# ITS (Genus)
plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType_GENUS <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly, "Fungi", "Genus", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType, color_ITS_genus)

plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType_GENUS$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days")) # reorder sample type 

ggsave(filename = "Y_Abundance_Sample_Type_Fruit_Type_GENUS.jpg", plot = plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType_GENUS, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")
```

### b. Individuals
```{r}
# subset phyloseq object 
ps_rare_16S_Indiv <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, LifeStage !="na" & Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")

ps_rare_ITS_Indiv <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, LifeStage !="na" & Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")
```

## 3. Pop

# III. Prevalence

## 1. All samples

### a. Calculation

```{r}
# function for a phyloseq object
estimate_prevalence_all <- function(physeq) {
  otu <- otu_table(physeq)
  if (taxa_are_rows(physeq)) {
    otu <- t(otu)
  }
  
  prev <- colSums(otu > 0) / nrow(otu)  # fraction of samples where each taxon is present (prevalence = % of samples where abundance > 0)
  rel_abund <- colMeans(otu / rowSums(otu))  # mean relative abundance
  
  tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq))
  tax$Taxon <- rownames(tax)
  
  data.frame(
    Taxon = colnames(otu),
    Prevalence = prev,
    RelativeAbundance = rel_abund
  ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(tax, by = c("Taxon" = "Taxon"))
  
}

# Apply function
B_absolute_prevalence <- estimate_prevalence_all(S_ps_rare_16S)
Y_absolute_prevalence <- estimate_prevalence_all(S_ps_rare_ITS)
```

### b. Plot

```{r}
B <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(B_absolute_prevalence, color_16S)  
ggsave( file =here::here("plots", "sido", "Community_composition","PrevalenceAbundance_All_16S.pdf"), plot = B, width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")

dev.off()
#rise the size of the plot window before plotting otherwise -> error
Y <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(Y_absolute_prevalence, color_ITS)  
ggsave( file =here::here("plots", "sido", "Community_composition","PrevalenceAbundance_All_ITS.pdf"), plot = Y, width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")
```
